plugin.name: Sessions
plugin.description: Persistent tmux sessions per host: create, rename, hibernate and reattach from one list.

use.title: Use persistent sessions
use.description: Create, rename, attach and terminate your own persistent tmux sessions.

hibernateIdleHours.label: Hibernate idle sessions after (hours)
hibernateIdleHours.description: Freeze the processes of a session with no attached client after this many idle hours. 0 turns hibernation off.

splitHint: Attach in a split next to the current tab

terminate.title: Terminate {{name}}?
terminate.description: The remote tmux process will be stopped.

force.title: Force remove?
force.unreachable: The host did not answer. Force remove deletes only this card and leaves any remote tmux process running.
force.mismatch: This remote session belongs to another record. Force remove clears only this card.

errors.invalidName: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (max 64).
errors.conflict: A session with this name already exists.

recovery.failed: Tabs could not be saved or restored. The exit confirmation remains enabled.
